name: odoo-hackathon-2026-starter
description: Full-stack hackathon starter skeleton with Laravel 13 API, React Vite, and Socket.io realtime

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,REALTIME,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "cd backend && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port 8000" "cd realtime && node server.js" "cd frontend && npm run dev -- --host"
